description: City of Casey Parking Restriction Zones is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Casey. Dataset containing the locations of parking restrictions within the City of Casey. Additional information provided includes parking zone restriction types and applicable times as well as relevant vehicle exemptions. Coverage: City of Casey. The portal files it under the publisher City of Casey. Its tags are boundary, cars, law, local, parking. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, JSON, KML, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-24 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other open licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
